blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Deep neural networks are vulnerable to backdoor attacks, in which adversaries manipulate model predictions by injecting poisoned samples into training data. Detecting these samples remains challenging because legitimate semantic variation can obscure poisoning-related signals in learned representations. Consequently, class-level statistics used by existing detectors may flag benign feature deviations while overlooking poisoned samples that blend into the class distribution. In this paper, we propose Semantic Counterfactual Residualization (SCR), which uses a small set of clean reference samples to account for benign variation through sample-specific feature reconstruction. SCR identifies poisoned samples by detecting coherent deviations from these clean baselines, without requiring prior knowledge of the attacks. We evaluate SCR through experiments covering twelve dirty-label and clean-label attacks across CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Tiny ImageNet. With a small clean-reference set, SCR achieves attack-averaged true positive rates above 99.5\% and false positive rates below 2\% on each dataset, outperforming eight representative detection baselines in macro-TPR.
blocks.zh: 深神经网络容易受到后门攻击,在后门攻击中,对手通过向训练数据中注入有毒样品来操纵模型预测. 检测这些样本仍然具有挑战性,因为正当的语义变异会模糊与中毒有关的信号在学到的表述中. 因此,现有探测器使用的分类统计数据可能标出良性特征偏差,而忽略混入分类分布的有毒样品。 在本文中,我们提出语义反事实残余(SCR),它使用一小组干净的参考样本,通过样本特定特征重建来说明良性变化. SCR通过检测与这些清洁基线的一致偏差来识别中毒样本,而不需要事先知道这些袭击。 我们通过实验来评估SCR, 涵盖整个CIFAR-10,CIFAR-100和Tiny ImageNet的12个脏标签和干净标签攻击。 使用小型的清洁参考集,SCR在每个数据集上达到攻击平均真实正率超过99.5+++,假正率低于2+++,在宏观TPR中表现优于8个有代表性的检测基线.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The widespread adoption of deep neural networks (DNNs) across diverse applications has raised growing concerns about their security. Among various threats, backdoor attacks pose a particularly insidious risk by injecting poisoned samples into training data to manipulate model predictions. As illustrated in Fig. 1 , such attacks can cause backdoored models to produce attacker-desired outputs when specific triggers are present, while maintaining high accuracy on benign inputs, making them difficult to identify through conventional evaluation. To mitigate this threat, poisoned-sample detection (PSD) aims to identify contaminated training examples for subsequent dataset purification.
blocks.zh: 各种应用中广泛采用深层神经网络(DNNs)引起了对其安全性越来越多的关注. 在各种威胁中,后门攻击构成特别险恶的风险,将有毒样品注入培训数据来操纵模型预测。 如图一所示,在出现特定触发器时,这种攻击可能导致后门模型产生攻击者所期望的输出,同时保持良性输入的高精度,使其难以通过常规评价来识别. 为了减轻这一威胁,毒物样本检测(PSD)旨在为随后的数据集净化确定被污染的培训实例.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Illustration of a data-poisoning-based backdoor attack. Poisoned training samples containing an attacker-defined trigger induce the backdoored classifier to predict the target class on triggered inputs while maintaining correct predictions on clean inputs.
blocks.zh: 图1:基于数据的后门攻击图示。 含有攻击者定义的触发器的有毒训练样品会诱导后门分级器在被触发输入上预测目标等级,同时保持对清洁输入的正确预测.

blocks.en: Existing PSD methods exploit diverse contamination signals from learned representations, activation gradients, prediction behavior, and training dynamics [ 25 , 23 , 6 , 16 , 34 , 13 , 4 ] . For example, Spectral Signatures and SPECTRE identify poisoning-related spectral abnormalities in learned representations, with SPECTRE employing robust covariance estimation and whitening [ 25 , 6 ] . Other approaches leverage class-level or higher-order feature statistics [ 23 , 16 ] , adaptively selected multi-layer representations [ 9 ] , or activation-gradient geometry [ 34 ] .
blocks.zh: 私营部门司现有方法利用从学到的表述、激活梯度、预测行为和培训动态中发出的不同污染信号[25、23、6、16、34、13、4]。 例如,光谱签名和SPECTRE在所学的表达法中识别出与中毒有关的光谱异常,SPECTRE采用强同位素估计和白化[25,6]. 其他方法利用等级分级或分级分高的地物统计[23,16],适应性地选择多层表示 [9],或活化-分级几何 [34].

blocks.en: A persistent challenge is that benign samples within the same class can exhibit substantial feature variation, potentially obscuring poisoning-related deviations. Existing methods address this issue through different statistical models. For instance, SCAn [ 23 ] decomposes learned representations into class identity and variation components, assuming a variation distribution shared across classes. Beatrix [ 16 ] instead identifies abnormal higher-order activation statistics using clean class-conditional references. Although these methods characterize benign variation, they do not explicitly remove the feature content that can be reconstructed from clean reference samples for each individual inspected sample. This motivates a complementary perspective: rather than relying solely on statistical characterization of learned representations, can we first account for the feature content of each sample that can be explained by a small set of clean references, and then examine the remaining deviations for poisoning-related structure?
blocks.zh: 一个持久的挑战是,在同一类中,良性样品可显示出显著的特征变化,从而可能掩盖与中毒有关的偏差。 现有方法通过不同的统计模式解决这一问题。 例如,SCAN [23] 将学到的表示分解为阶级身份和变异成分,假设各阶级共有变异分布. Beatrix [16] 取而代之的是,使用干净的类条件参考物,识别出异常高序活性统计. 尽管这些方法是良性变异的特征,但并未明确去除每个被检查的样本可从清洁参考样本中重建的特征内容. 这激发了一种互补的视角:我们不是只依靠对所学到的表述进行统计定性,而是可以首先说明每个样本的特征内容,这些特征内容可以用一小组干净的参考来解释,然后审查与中毒有关的结构的其余偏差?

blocks.en: To explore this idea, we consider a clean-reference baseline that adapts to each inspected representation. Within the same class, benign samples may be better explained by different combinations of clean reference features. A sample-conditioned reconstruction can therefore account for legitimate variation that a fixed class statistic may leave unexplained. If poisoning introduces feature content that cannot be adequately explained by the clean references, the corresponding deviation may persist in the reconstruction residual. However, a large residual alone does not necessarily indicate poisoning, since limited reference coverage can also leave benign variation unexplained. Rather than treating individual reconstruction errors as suspicious, we therefore seek coherent residual deviations that may arise from a shared backdoor mechanism. This motivates combining sample-conditioned clean-reference reconstruction with the detection of shared structure in the resulting residuals.
blocks.zh: 为了探讨这一想法,我们考虑一个与每个被检查代表情况相适应的清洁参考基线。 在同一类中,良性标本可以通过不同组合的清洁参考特征得到更好的解释. 因此,以样本为条件的重建可以说明一个固定类别统计数字可能未加解释的合理变化。 如果中毒引入了无法用干净的参考文献充分解释的特征内容,相应的偏差可能在重建后残留部分会持续存在. 然而,仅靠大量残留不一定表示中毒,因为有限的参考范围也可能使良性变化无法解释。 因此,我们不把个别重建错误视为可疑,而是寻求一种共享后门机制可能产生的连贯的剩余偏差。 这促使在样本条件下的清洁参考重建与检测由此产生的残余物中的共享结构相结合。

blocks.en: To realize this approach, we propose Semantic Counterfactual Residualization (SCR) for PSD. Given a classifier trained on a potentially poisoned dataset and a small clean reference set, SCR optimizes a convex combination of same-class clean reference features separately for each inspected sample. The resulting counterfactual residuals are then modeled using a class-wise anchored Gaussian mixture to estimate potential shared shifts. SCR screens classes exhibiting unusually strong shifts and identifies suspicious samples through directional scoring with clean-reference-calibrated thresholds.
blocks.zh: 为了实现这一办法,我们提议私营部门司采用语义反事实残余法。 鉴于接受过潜在中毒数据集和小型清洁参考数据集培训的分类员,SCR为每个检查样本分别优化了同级清洁参考特征的对流组合. 由此产生的反事实残留物随后被用分级锚定的高斯混凝土来模型化,以估计潜在的共享转移. SCR屏幕显示异常强烈变化的分数,通过方向分数,以干净的参考度校准阈值识别出可疑样本。

blocks.en: We evaluate SCR against eight baseline detectors across twelve backdoor attacks and three datasets. SCR achieves an macro-TPR above 99.5 % 99.5\% and an macro-FPR below 2 % 2\% on each dataset, outperforming the strongest baseline in macro-TPR. Ablation studies demonstrate the benefits of sample-conditioned reconstruction and coherent residual-shift detection. Furthermore, retraining after SCR-based dataset purification reduces the average attack success rate to below 1 % 1\% across all three datasets while maintaining overall clean accuracy within 0.3 0.3 percentage points of Oracle purification.
blocks.zh: 我们通过12起后门攻击和3个数据集,对照8个基线探测器对SCR进行评估。 SCR在每套数据集上实现大于99.5%的宏观TRP和低于2%的宏观FPR,超过了宏观TRP中最强的基准. 校正研究显示了以样板为条件的重建以及连贯的剩余班次探测的好处。 此外,在基于SCR的数据集净化后进行再培训,将所有三个数据集的平均攻击成功率降低到1%以下,同时将整体清洁精度保持在甲骨文净化0.3个百分点以内。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • We introduce a sample-conditioned counterfactual residual formulation that exposes potential poisoning-related deviations by reconstructing individualized clean-reference baselines. • We develop a counterfactual residual-based detection strategy that exploits coherent poisoning-related shifts through class-level screening and directional scoring, enabling attack-agnostic poisoned-sample detection. • We demonstrate SCR’s effectiveness across diverse backdoor attacks and datasets, achieving macro-TPR above 99.5 % 99.5\% with macro-FPR below 2 % 2\% . Extensive ablations and sensitivity analyses validate its key components.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献概述如下: 我们采用了一种附有样本条件的反事实残留制剂,通过重建个性化的清洁参考基准,暴露出与中毒有关的潜在偏差。 我们制定反事实残留检测战略,通过班级检查和定向分数,利用与中毒有关的连贯转变,使攻击-不可知性中毒-样本检测成为可能。 我们展现了SCR在各种后门攻击和数据集中的有效性,实现了99.5%的TPR以上,2 %以下的FPR以上。 广泛的模拟和敏感度分析验证了其关键组成部分。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Early backdoor attacks, such as BadNets and Blended, inject fixed patch triggers or blend predefined patterns into benign images [ 5 , 2 ] . Subsequent attacks introduce more diverse and stealthy trigger mechanisms. WaNet uses subtle spatial warping [ 17 ] , while SSBA generates sample-specific invisible triggers through image steganography [ 15 ] . BPP exploits image quantization and dithering to construct imperceptible triggers [ 31 ] , and FTrojan [ 29 ] introduces frequency-domain perturbations by modifying discrete cosine transform coefficients. TaCT employs source-specific poisoning with auxiliary cover samples [ 23 ] . Clean-label attacks preserve the original labels of poisoned samples. SIG embeds sinusoidal patterns into target-class images [ 1 ] , while LC uses adversarial perturbations to suppress benign features [ 26 ] . BAAT exploits semantic attributes as sample-specific triggers [ 37 ] , whereas COMBAT alternately optimizes a trigger generator and a surrogate model to strengthen clean-label poisoning [ 11 ] . Adap-Blend further weakens latent separability through asymmetric trigger injection and cover samples [ 19 ] . These attacks differ in trigger construction, label manipulation, and the resulting feature distributions, posing diverse challenges for poisoned-sample detection.
blocks.zh: 早期后门攻击,如BadNets和Blended,注入固定补丁触发器或将预先定义的图案混合到良性图像中[5,2]. 随后的攻击引入了更多样化和隐蔽的触发机制. WaNet使用微妙的空间摆动[17],而SSBA则通过图像刻度来生成特定样本的隐形触发器[15]. BPP利用图像的量化和分化来构建无法识别的触发器[31],而FTrojan [29]通过修改离散的相弦变系数引入了频率-域扰动. TACT使用有辅助覆盖样本的源特有中毒[23]. 清洁标签攻击保留了有毒样品的原始标签. SIG将sinusoidal图案嵌入目标类图像 [1],而LC则使用对抗性扰动来压制良性特征 [26]. BAAT利用语义属性作为样本特异性的触发器[37],而COMBAT则交替优化了触发器和代用模型来强化清洁标签中毒[11]. Adap-Blend通过不对称的触发注射和覆盖样本进一步削弱潜在分离性[19]. 这些攻击在触发构造,标签操纵,以及由此而来的特点分布方面各不相同,对毒物样本检测提出了多种挑战.

blocks.en: Existing backdoor defenses include trigger reconstruction [ 27 , 24 , 30 , 22 ] , compromised model detection and repair [ 14 , 32 , 36 , 33 ] , model inspection [ 28 , 18 ] , and poisoned-sample detection (PSD). Among PSD methods, Spectral Signatures identifies anomalous spectral patterns in learned representations [ 25 ] , while SPECTRE improves detection through robust covariance estimation and whitening [ 6 ] . SCAn decomposes representations into class identity and shared variation to identify contaminated populations [ 23 ] , whereas Beatrix detects abnormal higher-order activation statistics using Gram matrices [ 16 ] . FLARE identifies discriminative feature subspaces from multi-layer activations [ 9 ] , and AGPD exploits activation-gradient geometry for class screening and sample detection [ 34 ] . Other approaches obtain detection signals through additional training or prediction behavior. Confusion Training (CT) introduces dynamically mislabeled clean samples during training to make benign samples difficult to fit while retaining the model’s ability to fit backdoor poisons, allowing detection based on their different fitting behaviors [ 20 ] . SAM-enhanced detection uses sharpness-aware minimization to amplify backdoor-related activations [ 35 ] , while PSBD identifies suspicious samples through dropout-induced prediction shifts [ 13 ] . Unlike methods based on distributional statistics, activation patterns, or modified training behavior, SCR constructs a sample-conditioned clean-reference reconstruction for each inspected representation and detects coherent deviations in the resulting residual space. By combining individualized residualization with class-level screening and directional scoring, SCR provides a complementary approach to identifying poisoning-related structure.
blocks.zh: 现有的后门防御包括触发器重建[27,24,30,22],受损模型检测和修复[14,32,36,33],模型检测[28,18],和中毒-样本检测(PSD). 在私营部门司的方法中,光谱签名在学到的表示法中查明了异常的光谱图案[25],而SPECTRE则通过强力的共变性估计和白化来改进检测. [6]. SCAN将表示分解为阶级身份和共享变异,以识别被污染的人群[23];而Beatrix利用格拉姆矩阵检测出异常高序活性统计[16]. FLARE从多层活化中识别出有区别的特征子空间[9],AGPD利用活化-梯度几何来进行类筛选和样本检测[34]. 其他方法通过额外的训练或预测行为获得检测信号. Construction Training(CT)在训练期间引入了动态错误标签的清洁样品,以使良性样品难以被接合,同时保留模型装入后门毒药的能力,允许根据其不同的相配行为进行检测[20]. SAM-增强检测使用敏锐感知最小化来扩大后门相关活化[35],而PSBD则通过辍学引发的预测转移来识别出可疑样本[13]. 与基于分布统计、活化模式或被修改的训练行为的方法不同,SCR为每个被检查的表述构建了有样本条件的清洁参考重建,并检测由此而来剩余空间的一致偏差. 通过将个性化后遗症与分级筛选和方向分数相结合,SCR为识别与中毒有关的结构提供了一种补充方法.

blocks.en: 3 Threat Model
blocks.zh: 3 威胁模式

blocks.en: In this section, we introduce the threat model, including the goals and capabilities of both the attacker and defender.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们介绍了威胁模式,包括攻击者和捍卫者的目标和能力。

blocks.en: Attacker. We focus on single-target backdoor poisoning by a malicious data contributor. The attacker can modify a subset of the contributed training images and, when required by the attack, their labels. The goal is to make the trained model predict a designated target label y t y_{t} on inputs that satisfy the attack’s activation conditions while maintaining accuracy on benign inputs. The attacker has no control over the victim model or training procedure.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5个实验

blocks.en: We evaluate SCR’s effectiveness in detecting poisoned samples across three datasets and twelve dirty-label and clean-label attacks. We first describe the experimental setup and compare SCR with eight baseline detectors, followed by a case study illustrating its detection workflow. We then examine its key design choices through ablations and sensitivity analyses, and evaluate backdoor suppression and clean accuracy after dataset purification and retraining.
blocks.zh: 我们评价SCR在三个数据集和12个污名标签和干净标签攻击中检测出中毒样本的效果。 我们首先描述实验设置,并将SCR与8个基线探测器进行比较,然后进行个案研究,说明其探测工作流程。 然后,我们通过活化和敏感性分析来审查它的主要设计选择,并在数据集净化和再培训后评价后门压制和清洁准确性。

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验装置

blocks.en: We conduct experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100 [ 12 ] , and Tiny ImageNet [ 3 ] , using ResNet-18 [ 7 ] as the default architecture. Note that in our threat model, the defender has full control on the training process and thus free to choose any architecture, and the sole goal of the defender is to detect and filter the potential backdoor data that may exist in the potential poisoned dataset. By default, we set τ c ​ l ​ s = 10 \tau_{cls}=10 , β = 0.01 \beta=0.01 and use l ​ a ​ y ​ e ​ r ​ 4 layer4 of ResNet-18 to extract features from samples. Appendix A provides dataset statistics, feature dimensions, and implementation details.

blocks.en: We evaluate twelve representative backdoor attacks, including eight dirty-label attacks (BadNets [ 5 ] , Blended [ 2 ] , BPP [ 31 ] , FTrojan [ 29 ] , SSBA [ 15 ] , WaNet [ 17 ] , Adap-Blend [ 19 ] , and TaCT [ 23 ] ) and four clean-label attacks (BAAT [ 37 ] , COMBAT [ 11 ] , LC [ 26 ] , and SIG [ 1 ] ). In the main comparison, we focus on effective backdoor configurations with ASR > 80 % >80\% and small to moderate poisoning rates (typically 1 % 1\% or 5 % 5\% ). On CIFAR-100 and Tiny ImageNet, COMBAT, LC, and SIG are excluded because their attempted configurations did not meet the ASR criterion. Table 1 reports the poisoning rates for each evaluated configuration, while Appendix A.3 provides detailed attack configurations and undefended clean-test accuracy (ACC) and ASR. For dirty-label attacks, we report the global poisoning rate, defined as the proportion of poisoned samples in the entire training dataset. For attacks involving cover samples (Adap-Blend, TaCT, and WaNet), we additionally report the cover rate. For clean-label attacks, we report both the global poisoning rate and the target-class poisoning rate, defined as the proportion of poisoned samples within the target class. blocks.en: 5.2 Effectiveness of SCR

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 , SCR detects at least 98 % 98\% of poisoned samples in every evaluated setting and achieves the highest mean TPR across all three datasets, with a mean FPR below 2 % 2\% in each case. In contrast, every baseline fails to effectively detect poisoned samples under at least one attack on each dataset. The largest improvement over the strongest baseline is observed on CIFAR-100, where SCR outperforms SAM-Beatrix by 31 31 percentage points in macro-TPR while achieving a lower macro-FPR. On Tiny ImageNet, CT achieves the highest macro-TPR among the baselines but fails to detect any BAAT poisoned samples, whereas SCR detects all of them. Under Adap-Blend, SCR also achieves a higher TPR than AGPD while maintaining a substantially lower FPR ( 0.30 % 0.30\% versus 33.43 % 33.43\% ). These results demonstrate that SCR maintains high detection rates and low false-positive rates across diverse attacks, supporting its effectiveness in screening potentially poisoned training datasets.

blocks.en: By default, SCR first performs class-level screening to identify suspicious classes before applying sample-level filtering. Removing the class gate in Eq. ( 6 ) applies sample-level filtering to every class, including clean ones. Although trusted references and inspected samples in a clean class follow the same underlying distribution, the estimated shift direction is fitted adaptively from the inspected residuals and may capture incidental structures in their distribution. This can cause inspected samples to exhibit artificially elevated directional scores relative to the independently calibrated reference threshold, resulting in false positives. As shown in Table 2 , removing the gate leaves macro-TPR virtually unchanged but increases macro-FPR from at most 1.96 % 1.96\% to 47.07 47.07 – 63.03 % 63.03\% . This highlights the importance of class-level screening in preventing benign distributional variations from being misinterpreted as poisoning-related shifts.

blocks.en: By default, SCR uses the directional scoring function defined in Eq. ( 7 ) to assign a score to each sample for filtering. This result indicates that residual magnitude alone is less effective at identifying poisoned samples. In contrast, measuring alignment with the estimated shared shift improves macro-TPR, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed directional sample scoring.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose SCR that detect training samples poisoned by single-target backdoor attacks. It reconstructs sample representations from clean references and detects coherent residual shifts through anchored mixture modeling, class-level screening, and directional scoring. SCR requires no prior knowledge of the trigger, target class, or poisoning rate. Experiments covering twelve dirty-label and clean-label attacks across CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Tiny ImageNet yield attack-averaged TPR above 99.5 % 99.5\% and FPR below 2 % 2\% on each dataset, with higher macro-TPR than eight representative baselines. Ablations highlight the complementary roles of sample-specific reconstruction and class-level screening. Retraining after purification yields low ASR and mean overall clean ACC within 0.3 0.3 percentage points of Oracle on each dataset, although class-specific accuracy losses remain. Building on these results, future work will explore extending SCR’s class-level screening to more general multi-target settings and developing more reference-efficient and adaptive strategies for selecting clean reference samples, further broadening its applicability across diverse datasets and poisoning scenarios.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出通过检测单目标后门攻击所中毒的训练样本的SCR. 它从干净的参考文献中重建样本表述,通过锚定的混合物模型、阶级筛选和方向分数,检测出一致的残余转移。 SCR要求事先不知悉触发器,目标类或中毒率. 实验涵盖CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和Tiny ImageNet的12起污名标签和清洁标签攻击,每个数据集的平均TPR高于99.5% 99.5%和FPR低于2% 2%,宏观TPR高于8个有代表性的基线。 缺省突出了特定样本重建和阶级筛选的互补作用. 净化后的再训练产生较低的ASR,并意味着每个数据集总的清洁ACC在甲骨文0.3个百分点以内,尽管具体类别准确性的损失仍然存在. 在这些结果的基础上,今后的工作将探索将SCR的分级筛选扩大到更普遍的多目标环境,并制订更具有参考效率和适应性的战略来选择干净的参考样本,进一步扩大其适用于各种数据集和中毒情况。
